case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's sea-front location, beach access, views, cleanliness, friendly/professional staff and breakfast quality/views. Multiple reviews also noted noise from the lobby/entrance and limited soundproofing, and some guests reported restaurant availability/reservation problems. Isolated comments mentioned Wi‑Fi difficulties, lack of Portuguese TV channels, pricing concerns, and appreciated gestures like included minibar or surprise birthday treats.
